source.source: NOAA NCEI ETOPO2022 via NOAA CoastWatch ERDDAP
source.selection: Single Paris Basin lowland-context reference requested after first unmatched comparison. Center/bbox fixed before acquisition; no relief matching or crop optimization.
source.metricMethod: Local spherical tangent coordinates R=6371000 m; x=R*cos(49.0deg)*(lon-2.5deg), y=R*(lat-49.0deg), radians. No fitted scaling or vertical change.
